title: Homogenization, exact PSD lift size, and hyperbolic cone obstructions
exact_target: Characterize full-dimensional pointed closed convex cones that admit lifted linear-matrix-inequality representations with polynomial-time complexity. Is this efficiently representable class strictly larger than the class of hyperbolicity cones?
